question: At 55 mph, what advance placement distances does Table 2C-3 show for Condition A and for a potential stop condition?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For a posted or 85th-percentile speed of 55 mph, Table 2C-3 shows an advance placement distance of 990 feet for Condition A (speed reduction and lane changing in heavy traffic). For the potential stop condition (the Condition B "0 mph" column, covering signs such as Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead, and Signal Ahead), the table shows 495 feet. Standards (mandatory): - "The Stop Ahead (W3-1), Yield Ahead (W3-2), and Signal Ahead (W3-3) Advance Traffic Control signs (see Figure 2C-8) shall be installed on an approach to a primary traffic control device that is not visible for a sufficient distance to permit the road user to respond to the device (see Table 2C-3)." - "The Yield Ahead or Stop Ahead sign shall be located in accordance with Table 2C-3. The minimum distance between the signs shall be in accordance with Section 2C.04 and Table 2C-3." Guidance (recommended): - The 55 mph row of Table 2C-3 reads: "55 mph 990 ft 495 ft 275 ft 225 ft 200 ft 125 ft N/A⁵ — — —", i.e., 990 ft for Condition A and 495 ft for the 0 mph (potential stop) deceleration condition. - Per the table's footnotes, Condition A distances are adjusted for a sign legibility distance of 180 feet, and "for Conditions A and B, warning signs with less than 6-inch legend or more than four words, a minimum of 100 feet should be added to the advance placement distance." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Table 2C-3 shows the 55 mph row with 990 ft under Condition A and 495 ft under the Condition B "0³" column, whose footnote 3 identifies it as the warning of a potential stop situation (based on 2018 AASHTO stopping sight distance with a 2.5-second PRT and 11.2 ft/s² deceleration). [Image 2] Page 193 presents the same Table 2C-3 within Section 2C.04, Placement of Warning Signs, confirming the 55 mph values of 990 ft (Condition A) and 495 ft (potential stop). Citations: - Table 2C-3 (p.152) - Section 2C.04 Guidance §804 (p.153) - Section 2C.04 Guidance §5 (p.152) - Section 2C.35 Standard §1 (p.177) - Section 8B.06 Standard §3 (p.1001) - Page 193
gold_answer: 990 feet for Condition A and 495 feet for the potential stop condition.
